entries.original: Windows sandbox runs can now enforce proxy-only networking with OS-level egress rules, instead of relying on environment variables alone. (#12220)
entries.translated: Windows sandbox runs can now enforce proxy-only networking with OS-level egress rules, instead of relying on environment variables alone. (#12220) 추가

entries.original: App-server clients can now start ChatGPT sign-in with a device code flow, which helps when browser callback login is unreliable or unavailable. (#15525)
entries.translated: App-server clients can now start ChatGPT sign-in with a device code flow, which helps when browser callback login is unreliable or unavailable. (#15525) 추가

entries.original: `codex exec` now supports the prompt-plus-stdin workflow, so you can pipe input and still pass a separate prompt on the command line. (#15917)
entries.translated: `codex exec` now supports the prompt-plus-stdin workflow, so you can pipe input and still pass a separate prompt on the command line. (#15917) 추가

entries.original: Custom model providers can now fetch and refresh short-lived bearer tokens dynamically, instead of being limited to static credentials from config or environment variables. (#16286, #16287, #16288)
entries.translated: Custom model providers can now fetch and refresh short-lived bearer tokens dynamically, instead of being limited to static credentials from config or environment variables. (#16286, #16287, #16288) 추가

entries.original: Project-local `.codex` files are now protected even on first creation, closing a gap where the initial write could bypass normal approval checks. (#15067)
entries.translated: Project-local `.codex` files are now protected even on first creation, closing a gap where the initial write could bypass normal approval checks. (#15067) 수정

entries.original: Linux sandbox launches are more reliable because Codex once again finds a trusted system `bwrap` on normal multi-entry `PATH`s. (#15791, #15973)
entries.translated: Linux sandbox launches are more reliable because Codex once again finds a trusted system `bwrap` on normal multi-entry `PATH`s. (#15791, #15973) 수정

entries.original: The app-server-backed TUI regained several missing workflows: hook notifications replay correctly, `/copy` and `/resume <name>` work again, `/agent` no longer shows stale threads, and the skills picker scrolls past the first page. (#16013, #16021, #16050, #16014, #16109, #16110)
entries.translated: The app-server-backed TUI regained several missing workflows: hook notifications replay correctly, `/copy` and `/resume <name>` work again, `/agent` no longer shows stale threads, and the skills picker scrolls past the first page. (#16013, #16021, #16050, #16014, #16109, #16110) 수정

entries.original: MCP startup is more robust: local servers get a longer startup window, and failed handshakes surface warnings in the TUI again instead of looking like clean startups. (#16080, #16041)
entries.translated: MCP startup is more robust: local servers get a longer startup window, and failed handshakes surface warnings in the TUI again instead of looking like clean startups. (#16080, #16041) 수정

entries.original: On Windows, `apply_patch` is less likely to fail because it no longer adds redundant writable roots that could trigger unnecessary ACL churn. (#16030)
